description:
Which AI answers cite a domain, or what AI answers say for a keyword, from an already-crawled corpus (Google AI Overviews worldwide, ChatGPT US/EN): each answer, its sources (position, date), where the checked domain sits, AI search volume trend. Any domain, incl. prompts no audit asked. Saved as a report.

Billing: 75¢ at most per call — 5¢ per prompt found, at least 30¢. Not billed when nothing is found or the lookup fails. dry_run: true quotes it free.

When to call: coverage beyond your own audits ('where does asana.com get cited in AI answers'). Prompts competitors win in the site's audits: mine_competitor_prompts; one audit: get_audit.

Returns { report_id, url, target, platform, checked_domain, prompt_count, prompts_citing_checked_domain, unique_domains_cited, charged_cents, prompts: [{question, answer_preview, target_position, target_in_answer, sources: [{domain, url, position, publication_date?}], ai_search_volume, trend}] }: the 25 prompts with most AI search volume. checked_domain: the target (domain pull) or the site's domain (keyword pull); target_position: its 1-based place among sources (null: not cited).

domain.description: The site's domain as added to AuditAE, e.g. "acme.com". Or pass site_id.

dry_run.description: true: return the price quote (estimated_cents, max_cents, breakdown) and what would run. Nothing runs or bills.

limit.description: Prompts to pull, 1–100 (default 50; each found bills); the 25 with the most AI search volume are returned.

site_id.description: The workspace site to save the report on (site_id from list_sites). Or pass domain.

target.description: The domain (e.g. "linear.app") or keyword (e.g. "best pm tool for startups").

target_type.description: "domain": every prompt whose answer cites it; "keyword": the AI answers and cited domains for that prompt/topic.

name: explore_llm_mentions
title: Pull historical AI citation corpus for a domain or keyword
